text: バッグに　いれてある　どうぐを　べんりボタンに　とうろく　できます

structure.jp: バッグに　いれてある
structure.en: that has been put in the Bag

structure.jp: とうろく　できます

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: てある after a verb says someone did the thing earlier and it is still that way now. いれてある = 'has been put in'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: バッグに　いれてある　どうぐ
patterns.explanation: The phrase in front of どうぐ tells you which item is meant, like 'that...' in English. バッグに　いれてある　どうぐ = 'an item that has been put in the Bag'.

patterns.name: 〜できる
patterns.span: とうろく　できます
patterns.explanation: できる after an action word says you are able to do that action; できます is its polite form. とうろく　できます = 'you can register it'.
